# GovernanceSettings

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs generate` from `schemas/policy/v1.json`. Do not edit by hand. -->

The tenant's governance settings (#40). Every field is optional.

Appears at: `/policy/governance`.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Since | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `counter_report_hours` | integer | no | `24` | 1 to 168; format `uint16` | 1.0.0 | How often the agent reports hit counters, in hours: 1 to 168, default 24. |
| `expiring_soon_days` | integer | no | `14` | 1 to 365; format `uint16` | 1.0.0 | A rule that expires within this many days is expiring soon: 1 to 365, default 14. |
| `expiry_notice_days` | array of integer | no | `[14,3,0]` | at most 8 items | 1.0.0 | When the server tells a rule's owner that it expires, in days before the expiry: at most 8 values, each at most 365, default `[14, 3, 0]`. |
| `require_justification` | boolean | no |  |  | 1.0.0 | Governance mode: allow, trust, exclusion and exception rules need a justification, allow and trust rules a review date, and exception rules an expiry, an approver and a risk rating. Unset means on for a policy with a compliance preset (`unknown.preset`) and off otherwise. |
| `severity` | map of [`FindingSeverity`](types.md#findingseverity) | no |  | keys: one of `weak_identity`, `user_writable_path_allow`, `restricted_publisher_broad`, `broad_wildcard`, `shadowed`, `contradiction`, `ineffective_vs_mandatory`, `duplicate_rule`, `duplicate_principal`, `expired_rule_present`, `expiring_soon`, `review_overdue`, `stale_rule`, `revoked_or_expired_signer`, `vulnerable_version_allowed`, `missing_justification`, `exception_without_expiry`, `too_many_hash_rules`, `regex_cost` | 1.0.0 | The severity of policy-assistant findings, per finding code, replacing the default. |
| `stale_after_days` | integer | no | `90` | 1 to 3650; format `uint16` | 1.0.0 | A rule with no hits for this many days, while usage was observed, is stale: 1 to 3650, default 90. |
